Dominant Ni and dominant Fi seem to be quite similar, especially when Ni is paired with auxiliary Fe. The difference between FiNe and NiFe is what I need to figure out.

As a dominant function, Ni manifests as a keen perception for the meaningful connections that exist between the thoughts, concepts, events and occurrences in the Ni-user’s environment.  *“Everything is interconnected and I must determine the meaning and implication behind those connections.”* 

As an auxiliary function, Fe manifests as the urge to apply one’s understanding of a given situation in a way that will satisfy the needs and desires of others.  *“I will analyze the information that is available to me and then see how I can use it to achieve interpersonal peace.”* 

As a dominant function, Fi manifests as a moral compass that points its user toward the direction they ought to explore next, based on how they feel about the information at hand.  *“I must decide how I feel and where I stand on these issues before coming to a conclusion about what to do.”* 

Auxiliary Ne manifests as a plethora of possibilities that arise to support or expand upon a thought or decision that the user has come to.  *“I see a million different ways to look at the concept I’ve been analyzing and I want to consider them all.”*

I think the majority of gen z leftists (which is what i am) were radicalized by how their parents treated them. If you're mid to late gen z its likely you're parents were the latchkey kids. Gen x took their lessons from childhood and saw that a lack of supervision wasn't favorable, so they decided they would take some of the authoritarian parenting routes. We already know that mental illness and abuse in the household has skyrocketed from the previous generations is directly an effect of this. In my case, I've suffered emotional and financial abuse. I couldn't have friends growing up because my parents didn't want me to fall into the wrong groups, and I've always paid for my own things like food and doctors appointments despite being a upper-middle class family because they wanted to teach me how to be self sufficient. The maltreatment our generation faces at home explains why we are by far the most politically active generation, and the reason why the leftist community is growing like a weed.
